widgets_values: A woman with long, straight brown hair and bangs, wearing an off-the-shoulder black ribbed top, stands indoors in a modern, minimalist space with neutral walls and ceiling-mounted lights. The scene begins with her facing the camera, smiling warmly. Over the first 1.5 seconds, she tilts her head slightly to one side, maintaining eye contact and broadening her smile. In the next 1.5 seconds, she raises her right hand to gently adjust her hair while resting her left hand lightly on her chest, her smile softening slightly. Finally, over the last 2 seconds, she lowers her right hand and brings both hands together in front of her chest in a graceful gesture, her smile becoming radiant and inviting. The camera slowly zooms out slightly to capture her full upper body, creating a sense of closure.
